text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day off, I decide to have lunch off
campus
for a change of pace, and find
myself unable to
decipher a menu
written in a foreign language.

Hah, looks like you don't know a lick of
French.
choice_data_list_en: (I have no idea what's going on...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn to toward the voice coming from
the next
table next over.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can't read the menu, can you? Need
some
help?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I'll only tell you what it says,
though. It's still
up to you to figure out
what's good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her words are strangely loaded. Should I
swallow
my pride and ask for help?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Suit yourself. Hope that works out for
you.
choice_data_list_en: I'll do my best on my own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, after I manage to order...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What's this? Nothin' but veggies? That's
some
luck you got there.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come on, cheer up. Meals are supposed
to be
happy occasions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I better lend you a hand.
Here, pass
your plate over.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: All finished. It wasn't bad, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A meal of only veggies really leaves
something to
be desired. It's not filling.
You know what I'm
saying, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Take me right now, for example. I'm still

famished, and here in front of me,
there's a...
soft... juicy...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha, hahaha! Relax, I'm not gonna
gobble
you up or anything.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Not this time, at least.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good on you for being honest. Now,
let's start
with some appetizers...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli explains the menu items
and places
the order for me. Shortly
after...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
An appetizer, soup, and a main to top it
off. Not
bad, eh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: You're thanking me?
choice_data_list: 教えてくれてありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now. It's a bit early for that,
don't you
think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I ponder what she means until the food
is
delivered... and she moves it all to her
own table.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hate to break it to you, but I was just
giving you
an example. In other words, I
was ordering for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't look at me like that! You'll
only make
me want to tease you more.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now try and order on your own. Show
me whether
or not you've learned
anything.
